architecture.implementationOwner: Existing packages/work-continuity; add a small git-work public subpath rather than a new package, service or agent runtime
entrypoints: Optional small common Bun CLI for validate/context/source/start-readback; no provider client, scheduler, sessions or credential bridge
architecture.legacyRule: Preserve every currently published legacy export and bytes unless an exact reviewed compatibility successor is necessary. Native Leads migrate their callers separately; do not delete handoff/checkpoint APIs in this PR.
architecture.noHotspotIndex: work.json contains identity, purpose, scope and contract refs, not a mutable array listing every Task/decision. Deterministic ID-to-path mapping plus Git tree listings avoid forcing independent Task creation through one global index.
architecture.identity: Retain Domain/Project/Work/Issue/Spec+revision/Plan+revision/Task identity. Validate canonical Work-key ownership and path uniqueness; Git SHA is a version, never the logical Work/Task ID.
architecture.ontologyReuse: Use immutable Ontology0.2.0 Artifact envelopes/validation where records already have those kinds. Work/relation/effect wrappers are clearly named local common-harness contracts; do not edit immutable releases or invent another general object/action execution engine.
architecture.noRedundantVersionStore: Git commits/trees/blobs own file history and publication concurrency. Keep semantic Spec/Plan revisions and native attempt/occurrence IDs; do not add checkpoint version counters, base64 envelopes, private replication daemons or a second CAS store.

recordSemantics.work: Stable owner/purpose/success criteria/in-scope/out-of-scope and active Spec/Plan refs; migration/legacy baseline reference and original whole-Work Acceptance remain distinct.
recordSemantics.decision: Separate original answer text, interpretation/rationale, scope/status and explicit supersession relation. Bind original text and selection context to exact source blob fragments or an existing native/original-owner receipt; a sourceKind label alone is insufficient.
recordSemantics.task: Logical identity, intent, direct dependencies, required decisions/context IDs and operational state. Reuse the existing five-axis execution/verification/localAudit/sharedAudit/formalCompletion invariant.
recordSemantics.relation: Typed endpoints and meaning, including purpose/contains/dependsOn/supersedes/implements/verifiedBy; validate target identity/scope, missing endpoints and relevant dependency cycles.
recordSemantics.effect: Stable effect ID plus native occurrence/attempt/reference and completed/uncertain state. Git stores semantic references, not an invented execution result. Completed effects must never be queued again; uncertain effects require observation before retry.
recordSemantics.evidence: Source observation, verification, review, native execution and Acceptance remain different record classes. Git commit/PR merge is source integration and cannot synthesize runtime verification or Acceptance.
recordSemantics.provenanceQualification: Common APIs establish source/fragment integrity and scoped semantics only. Native authorship/authentication, source-owner custody and actual effects remain with native/original owners; result authority remains none.

sourceAddressing.readInput: GitSnapshotSelection { repositoryId, immutable commit OID, local checkout root, canonical Work key }
sourceAddressing.canonicalSameSnapshotReference: { path, optional blob/content hash, fragment }; repository and commit are inherited from the selected immutable snapshot
sourceAddressing.externalReference: { repositoryId, immutable commit OID, relativePath, blob/content hash, fragment } for an already existing Git source, or an explicitly typed native/original-owner locator with its receipt
sourceAddressing.resolvedReadReceipt: { repositoryId, commit, relativePath, blobOid, byteLength, optional sha256, fragment, verificationClass }
sourceAddressing.avoidSelfReference: Never embed the current commit SHA in a record committed by that same commit. Same-snapshot refs resolve under the caller snapshot, then produce fully qualified read receipts. This avoids an extra decision-publication lane or SHA-injection commit.
sourceAddressing.localPathPolicy: Absolute paths exist only in adapter invocation and returned local diagnostics, never in canonical common record identity.
sourceAddressing.gitReader: Use native Git object/ref primitives with argument arrays, explicit verified commit objects, bounded blob reads and regular-file mode checks. Read the committed object, not a mutable working-copy path. Reject traversal, symlink/submodule records, ambiguous refs, wrong scope and oversized selected inputs.
sourceAddressing.identityClaim: repositoryId is checked against selected Work identity and caller admission; a local Git read is not GitHub authentication or proof that a remote branch is current.
sourceAddressing.availability: Missing required source holds its dependent context/effect qualification only. Read-only diagnostics and independent Task context remain available. No remote fetch or credential discovery is implicit in a source lookup.

operationalInvariantPromotion.from: Current active work-continuity/interview-history contracts.ts:7-10,20-25 and operational.ts:26-38; logical identity checks validation.ts:61-67
operationalInvariantPromotion.to: One small neutral canonical operational-state source in the remote-main successor
exactRules: Formal completion requires execution complete, verification passed, local result durable and shared audit delivery confirmed
Audit-synchronization-pending requires successful durable execution with shared delivery still pending
Uncertain execution cannot claim passed verification or formal completion
Logical identity contains complete Domain-through-Task fields and positive Spec/Plan semantic revisions
operationalInvariantPromotion.admission: Record source hashes and reviewed extracted scope. No absolute import from the active checkout, no full interview/corpus engine promotion, and no competing maintained implementation. Future legacy wrapper migration must forward to the successor invariant.
operationalInvariantPromotion.portableReceiptAdaptation: Reuse the semantics; source pins in the new route use Git/native-owner references instead of copied absolute checkpoint paths.

initialCanonicalWorkSubset.sourceCopies: Copy only explicitly admitted common decision capture blobs needed to make the new shared route reproducible; preserve exact bytes and original native/original-store ownership. Do not bulk-copy private sessions, unrelated originals, credentials or all1003checkpoint pins.
initialCanonicalWorkSubset.historicalFence: Retain stable prior completed/uncertain IDs conservatively for no-replay. Historical reference records do not claim a new native verification or formal common completion. Dependencies requiring an unavailable original receipt remain held.
initialCanonicalWorkSubset.sourceCommitBinding: Initial same-snapshot records point to in-tree input/evidence paths and get a fully qualified commit binding in read receipts after commit.
initialCanonicalWorkSubset.acceptanceBoundary: This PR can complete the bounded common source/API implementation and publication. It cannot set the original both-runtime whole-Work Acceptance to accepted or claim host-native activation.

endToEndAcceptance.criterion: Real Git fixture commits one Work plus actual-answer capture/decision, Task dependencies, relation/effect and verification records. A fresh clone at another absolute path reads the same snapshot and produces the same logical context/source identities.

Two independently reviewable Task edits on separate branches do not mutate a shared checkpoint/index. Pure Git integration preserves compatible changes; semantic transition validation rejects an individually valid pair whose combined dependency/completion graph is invalid.

A claimed actual answer or selected option that disagrees with its committed original fragment is rejected. A proposal/verification record cannot stand in for an actual user answer merely through a trusted label.

Completed-effect loss/replay and uncertain-effect execution are rejected; locally durable execution, shared delivery, formal completion and Acceptance remain independent. Cross-runtime prerequisite receipt use requires explicit receiver evidence.

Selected Task context reads only its required purpose/decision/dependency closure. An unrelated malformed/missing historical record does not globally block that Task; missing latest required source holds only dependent qualification, with explicit diagnostics.

New-Work startup requires the explicit newly synchronized main baseline; same-Work continuation retains stable IDs and its chosen branch. A stale/unobserved remote-main assertion cannot silently claim fresh startup. No hidden reset, auto merge or second decision lane occurs.

Unsafe Git paths, wrong owner/commit, symlink/submodule records, ambiguous identities and selected-source budget overruns fail before dependent use. Dirty worktree changes do not masquerade as the selected committed bytes.

The legacy package/entrypoint contract remains callable through the existing compatibility tests and exact package-import readback. Ontology immutable archives and native adapter/config bytes remain unchanged.

The actual selected Work records in this PR validate and can be read from the final reviewed/merged Git commit. The final source tree, native independent review, checks, PR and explicit Lead merge have source-owned receipts; native WSL2/VPS activation remains deferred.
The shared Runtime Index remains a docs-only subject/version/topic selector with generated thin host-pointer data, no native execution/approval authority and no live host publication in this PR.
